Prepared by the review panel — seven independent AI reviewer contexts, one per lens, none of which read another's report before writing its own. Patina · 8 September 2026.

Sheet 02 / 18

Method

What we reviewed

This sheet continues below.

  1. RendersThe proposal's fifteen slides and the two shipped portals, captured at 1440 and 390 — including its four interactive states on slide 7 and its compact-roster state on slide 8.
  2. SourceComponents read directly, not inferred: desk-roster.tsx, desk-roster-derivation.ts, recent-boards-strip.tsx, room-band.tsx, plan-key.tsx, tracking-row.tsx, scored-action.tsx, wall-gate.tsx, doorstep.tsx, story-pole.tsx, command-bar.tsx, mat.tsx, and both portals' globals.css.
  3. OrderSeven cold reads, each formed before its reviewer opened the rulings: the findings are about what renders, not about what is permitted.
  4. ReportingEvery finding carries confidence and severity, and every one was reported. Nothing was filtered at source; the filtering happened at synthesis. Every number printed in these sheets was recomputed from the hex values or read off the render, not carried over.
  5. LimitsNo live portal was signed into in this round. The current-state captures are dated, not live: the Desk is a 28 August build, the house page a 4 September build, the invoice a 6 September mockup. One capture, client‑path‑b‑desktop.png, is 393×1400 rather than the desktop width its name claims (IX48). And no designer and no homeowner has seen any of this — sheet 18, step 3 is where that happens.

Where it breaks its own system

This sheet continues below.

Craft findings, not gotchas. Every one is a build detail fixable in an afternoon — we list them because the proposal asks us to adopt the system it describes, and its file is the only place that system exists.

  • VC-0125 font sizes ship (10–48px plus two clamps) against a stated six-step scale.

  • VC-1355 hex literals in a nine-token stylesheet; roughly 40 appear once and are named nowhere.
  • VC-21Twelve radii ship against a stated 6px; slide 6 stacks six of them.
  • VC-48 · A48Record (flat) and Object (an 8px lift at ~6% alpha) are indistinguishable at render. The case for amending the depth ban fails on its own specimen board.
  • IX22.primary carries a fourth elevation: a 0 2px 3px depth declaration below their own stated Record / Object / Sheet triad.

On the slide arguing that materials need room to speak

BE‑18 · VC‑38 — “Natural oak” and “Smoked oak” are repeating‑linear‑gradient stripes at 95px. They read as corrugated card. The slide arguing for materials contains no material.

VC‑39 — the one enlarged product preview, captioned “Solid oak table”, is a stock photograph of a green-velvet dining room with a glass top.

The fix is photography of the studio's own samples at real scale, captioned with maker and species. Not a better gradient.

Must keep

What the shipped portals already do better than anything in the proposal

This sheet continues below.

The panel agreed on this list without being asked to. Whatever changes, these do not.

  • VC (keep 1)Scored ink: three ranks by rule-count and pigment rather than three box styles. Nothing in the proposal is this well drawn.
  • VC (keep 2) · IA“Good morning, Leah” in Playfair over a DM Mono caps date: authorship, warmth and precision in two lines, with no photograph and no avatar. This is why the “LW” disc is declined on sheet 17.
  • IA-03 · L1The overdue trio: “EVERY JOB · 16 LIVE · 1 OVERDUE”, then “One thing is overdue — Vandersteen.”, then a terracotta line on the row. Three levels of one fact, each legible alone.
  • B08The stage plates: seven plates in six pigments (Care shares Install's), white 11px mono, the count inside, 5.22–8.20:1. Colour genuinely supplementary, and the fastest scan device on either surface at real load.
  • IA (keep 4)The house ledger and letterbox pair, marked data‑never‑dim so a dimming pass cannot hide money owed. The single most professional decision in either portal.
  • IX (keep 3)HoldAction and consent‑copy.ts: 900ms, keyboard hold parity, scroll cancels, early release is a silent cancel, reduced motion stills the fill but keeps the wait — and consent lines drift-tested against the signing API. Defensible if disputed.
  • VC (keep 5) · BEThe FF&E stamps: a twelve-state inspection stamp on four dials, ageing in border weight only, never in the word. A real identity asset.
  • BE-26The invoice: letterhead, itemised makers, a signed note, three payment methods each honestly priced, one filled dark act carrying the exact amount, and a colophon.
  • BE (keep 9) · VCThe letterhead and the doorplate, read as a drawing-set title block. The page states who prepared it and for whom before it states anything else.
  • C06TrackingRow's screen-reader contract: one sr‑only stage sentence, the decorative marks hidden so nothing is read twice, and a designed placeholder for both a null URL and a 404.
  • B09Three real muted steps — 9.22 / 7.73 / 6.51 on document paper — with hover washes that shift the ground only 1.11–1.14:1, and the ratios written into the CSS.
  • IA-46 · VCAbsence is silence, and the deep-link fold: a region with nothing to say renders nothing, and #door, #wall, #letterbox and #previously resolve at first paint, so an emailed link lands correctly.

Sheet 10 / 18

The thesis

Five principles of polish and professionalism

This sheet continues below.

These five are the whole ruling. Sheet 18 asks for a yes or a no on each; sheets 11–13 give the evidence and sheets 14–16 the proof.

  1. OneThe studio is the author; Patina is the press.Every client surface opens with a two-sided letterhead and closes with a colophon; no Patina wordmark above it, and never a placeholder identity.
  2. TwoMoney, dates and names carry the largest true type.A 15px floor in sentence case for every money figure, date, party name and consequence sentence; one family for money; the owed figure outranks the agreed figure; one date style.
  3. ThreeEvery act shows its weight and its consequence.Three tiers assigned by consequence and never by page, one consequence sentence above every terminal act, and the act replaced by its dated record once taken.
  4. FourHonest imagery at real scale.Installed photograph, then the studio's own board or scan, then the maker's product photograph, then a drawn silhouette — enforced by caption. Never a procedural fill, never stock, never a generated room captioned as the client's.
  5. FiveOne scale, one rhythm; absence is silence.Seven type steps, a 24px module, three radii, three paper stocks and state pigments only. A region with nothing to say renders nothing. Wrap, never truncate.

Principle three

Every act shows its weight and its consequence

This sheet continues below.

Three tiers, assigned by consequence and never by page. Below are the real controls, with the real CSS: hover them, tab to them.

Tertiary · a resting rule at 4.20:1
Secondary · the two-score word
Inline · a tertiary act inside a sentence

waits for your acceptance.

States, as specimens

FocusOpen the letterbox
Unavailable

The focus cell is shown, not focusable — tab the three controls above to see the real ring on a live act.

Type your full name to accept. The control keeps its role and its place in the tab order — aria‑disabled, never disabled, and never opacity: .5.

 

  • B01 · IX03 · IX04The rest rule is unconditional: no scaleX(0), no hover-only variant. The shipped resting score measures 1.75:1; --oak #8B7355 measures 4.20:1.
  • IX42One consequence sentence at 15px above every terminal act, in every state including unavailable. It says what the act does and what it does not do.
  • A23 · IX07The focus ring here is 2px at 2px offset in --clay‑ink, which measures 5.61:1 on paper. That is a deliberate reduction from the proposal's 3px at 4px offset at 8.78:1: the pigment is darker, so the ring reads at less geometry. Sheet 17 records the trade rather than hiding it.
  • A16 · C05The real disabled attribute removes the gate from the tab order and takes its reason with it. Activating an aria‑disabled act moves focus to the unmet input and writes the reason into the page's status line; it never silently does nothing.
  • N5 · N7 · IX09Selection and authorization are different tiers. A checkbox records that someone understood; a typed name records who. Today, paying $9,125.00 is one click while accepting $2,980.00 of finished work needs a typed name and a 900ms hold.
  • VC-10 · IX10On the invoice, $9,125.00 is the balance and $9,130.00 is the button, which includes the $5.00 transfer fee. The two figures differ honestly, and the page should say so in a sentence rather than leave a reader to reconcile them.
  • IX11 · BE-14After the act, the act is replaced by its record: a stamp, a subject, a reference number, the parties, a date, what happens next, where it is filed, and the way back. Never a taken act left enabled beside its own state.

Sheet 13 / 18

Principles four & five

Honest imagery at real scale. One scale, one rhythm; absence is silence.

This sheet continues below.

The source hierarchy, enforced by caption · BE-20

  1. 1An installed photograph: the piece standing in her room.
  2. 2The studio's own board or scan still: her house, drawn or captured by the studio.
  3. 3The maker's product photograph: the piece, at real scale, credited.
  4. 4A drawn silhouette: an inline outline of the piece on document paper.

Never a procedural fill. Never stock. Never a generated room captioned as the client's. Every plate captioned what it is · whose it is · when, at 12px — these sheets hold that rule too, and every plate here carries its capture date.

  • BE-21 · IA-32Piece plates at 96–120px on desktop above a value threshold, 64px in dense schedules. An $8,120.00 reading chair is not list furniture.
  • IA-31 · VC-45An empty room is a floor line and one sentence — never a rectangle. A region with nothing at all to say renders nothing: no heading, no rule, no zero.
  • C01The room drawing's footprint labels hold an eleven-pixel rendered floor on a phone, ported from plan‑key.tsx.
  • BE-22Honesty comes from the caption, not from absence. Line drawings alone are honest and dull, and dull reads as cheap.

Specimen three

Two acts, two weights

This sheet continues below.

Two tiers, two weights · N5, N7, IX09, IX10“Note my choice” is secondary and reversible. “Accept · $2,980.00” is terminal, because money moves. Tier follows consequence, never the page.

One consequence sentence · IX42, A10At 15px, directly above the act, present in every state including unavailable: what the act does, and what it does not do.

Typed name and hold · IX01, C05, A16The name records who. The hold is announced in ink beneath the act. The control stays focusable with aria‑disabled and a named reason.

The record · BE-14, IA-24A stamp, a subject, an authorization number, the parties, a date, what happens next — and the way back to the house. Focus moves to the record heading and the status line says what was committed.

The act is replaced · IX11Once taken, the control leaves the page. No taken act stands enabled beside its own state chip.

Failure in body ink · VC-14, A31A refusal is body ink under a hairline with a named recovery. No error red, no colour-only cue, no toast.
